clues.q: Albuquerque is the largest city in which US state?

connect.link_note: Songs Numb and Crawling, debut album Hybrid Theory, and the name itself: Lincoln + Park (after Lincoln Park in Santa Monica).

clues.q: What word describes a body part you can't feel, like a sleeping foot?
clues.link: Numb is one of Linkin Park's biggest songs.

clues.q: What do babies do on their hands and knees before they walk?
clues.link: Crawling is a Linkin Park song from Hybrid Theory.

clues.q: What do you call a car that runs on both petrol and electricity?
clues.link: Hybrid Theory is Linkin Park's debut album.

clues.q: Which US president is on the five-dollar bill?
clues.link: Lincoln is the first half of the band's name.

clues.q: Which 1993 Steven Spielberg film brings dinosaurs back to life?
clues.link: Park is the second half of the band's name.

connect.link_note: Roles he played: Chaplin (1992), Dolittle (2020), Oppenheimer (Oscar win), Sherlock Holmes, and Iron Man.

clues.q: Which silent-film comedian was famous as 'The Tramp'?
clues.link: Robert Downey Jr. played him in Chaplin (1992), his first Oscar nomination.

clues.q: Which fictional doctor can talk to animals?
clues.link: He played the title role in Dolittle (2020).

clues.q: Which 2023 Christopher Nolan film won the Oscar for Best Picture?
clues.link: His role as Lewis Strauss won him the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor.

clues.q: Which fictional detective lives at 221B Baker Street?
clues.link: He played Holmes in Sherlock Holmes (2009) and its 2011 sequel.

clues.q: Which metal is the main ingredient in steel?
clues.link: Tony Stark, Iron Man (2008), the role that defined him.
